old_claim: Score 0-10 with ~65% of effective weight in single-rater rubrics
new_evidence: Computed in v3 audit (see automated check AC01); no second rater exists
correction: v3 reports rubric share, a quant-only score and rank frequencies; agreement only computed when real ratings are supplied
potential_impact: Ranking order 3-8 not robust; Brazil/Thailand gap depends partly on CR rubric

new_evidence: No elicitation record; weights chosen by analyst
correction: v3 samples weights from a Dirichlet around each scenario and reports rank frequency instead of a single order
potential_impact: Top-2 stable; positions 3-6 change frequently

new_evidence: Sugar/mill integration enters PE (sugar, steam) and again in CR (existing plant next to mill); automated check AC02 reports cross-country correlation of criterion scores
correction: v3 shows correlation matrix and moves site-specific integration into the site economics (brownfield modules), not into a score
potential_impact: Brazil advantage partially double-counted in the score

old_claim: Distance to China/Vietnam/Chile measures market access
new_evidence: Priority markets were chosen by the analyst and China/Vietnam/Chile are candidates themselves (circularity). v2 'export_only' fix removes 0 km self-distance but keeps analyst-chosen nodes
correction: v3 economics uses exogenous demand nodes from market_demand_scenarios.csv (replaceable by the market study) and lane costs + lead-time capture, not a distance score
potential_impact: Small on score (China -0.06 in v2); larger on site economics via lead time

old_claim: Country score answers where to build
new_evidence: A national average is not a site: water, power, sugar contracts and licences are site-specific
correction: v3 separates country screening (ranking_v3.csv) from site economics (unit_economics.csv, cashflow_by_scenario.csv) and site gates
potential_impact: Final decision now by site NPV under gates

new_evidence: Flat factor not derived from modules; same 20 kt size imposed on both; existing utilities may not have spare steam
correction: v3 builds capex by module (fermentation, downstream, utilities, effluent, buildings, EPC/owner) with explicit shared-utility factors and a 'no spare steam' case
potential_impact: Brazil advantage shrinks if utilities must be duplicated

new_evidence: No Corbion disclosure of incremental capacity; EUR 50m capacity undisclosed (S004)
correction: Module size is a decision variable (5-20 kt); demand absorption tested; EUR 50m shown only as an implied-capacity sensitivity
potential_impact: Utilisation and NPV depend on demand absorption

new_evidence: Derived from a lab yield (0.103 g DHA/g glucose) at 30% DHA; lab values are upper bounds; SKU spec is min 35% DHA (S011)
correction: v3 mass balance: sugar = DHA fraction / (yield x recovery); base 0.075 g/g with 0.055-0.10 range -> ~5 kg sucrose/kg SKU
potential_impact: Raises cash cost in both countries; Thailand more exposed (higher sugar price)

old_claim: Real WACC applied to constant-2025-USD flows
new_evidence: Tax depreciation on historical capex is nominal: discounting real flows with real-valued depreciation overstates the tax shield; FX treated as a level factor only
correction: v3 models nominal USD flows (local costs indexed by local inflation and converted at a PPP-consistent FX path plus real-FX shocks) discounted at nominal USD WACC
potential_impact: Small upward bias of v2 NPV/low MSP; larger for Brazil (34% tax)

old_claim: Pillar Two caps the BOI holiday at exactly 15%
new_evidence: QDMTT applies to jurisdictional ETR (blending with Corbion Rayong taxable entities) and only on excess profit after SBIE carve-out; QRTC may change treatment
correction: v3 models top-up = (15% - ETR) x (GloBE income - SBIE) as a switch (applies / does not apply) with legal opinion pending
potential_impact: Thailand NPV range widens; base keeps top-up

new_evidence: Effective tax depends on loss carryforward (30% cap), depreciation, and indirect-tax credit leakage
correction: v3 tax ledger per entity with NOL cap and depreciation
potential_impact: Timing of tax in ramp-up years

new_evidence: World Bank LPI 2023 confirmed 2.9 in v2
correction: Kept 2.9; no replacement by guess

new_evidence: Iansa ended domestic beet purchases (S026). Zero is a true zero for domestic feedstock, but imported sugar remains possible
correction: Kept as true zero with REVIEW gate (not FAIL); imported-sugar option noted
potential_impact: Chile remains outside shortlist

new_evidence: Mixed definitions: CFIA 'aquatic feed' (China, 2024), Alltech survey (India), association projections (Brazil, Thailand), derived from export WFE x FCR (Chile). WFE export x FCR is not feed consumption
correction: Flagged; in v3 aquafeed is not used in site economics (demand comes from the market study file)
potential_impact: Market Access scores of China/Chile uncertain

new_evidence: Brazil = CEPEA crystal ex-mill (Jul 2025) / BRL 5.59; Thailand = controlled white ex-refinery (Sep 2024). Different product (crystal vs white), date and delivery terms; neither is a VHP/juice contract to a fermenter
correction: v3 uses delivered-sucrose prices per site with explicit basis (S017 Aug-2026; S018/S019) and ranges
potential_impact: Sugar is the largest swing factor of the Brazil-Thailand gap

new_evidence: GlobalPetrolPrices business tariffs are not contracted industrial/PPA or mill-cogeneration costs
correction: v3 site-specific power cost with tariff as high case
potential_impact: Moderate

old_claim: National water stress represents site water risk
new_evidence: SDG 6.4.2 is national with 2018 observation vintage; Aqueduct sub-basin data not retrieved
correction: Site water gate = NOT_VERIFIED until basin data/outorga are obtained
potential_impact: Rayong (EEC drought) and Nakhon Sawan (Chao Phraya) unresolved

new_evidence: Capex per t of BIOMASS capacity; v2 also reported per kg DHA via 30% content. Mixing biomass, oil, pure DHA and incremental-capacity bases invalidates comparisons with Veramaris (oil) or Corbion EUR 50m (incremental, unknown t)
correction: v3 canonical units: t SKU (P3 powder), kg DHA; capex per t/yr SKU nameplate; no comparison with oil-based plants without conversion
potential_impact: Prevents false benchmarking

new_evidence: MSP is the price for NPV=0, not a realized price or IRR
correction: v3 reports NPV/IRR only for an explicit price assumption and the MSP separately
potential_impact: Avoids reading MSP as return

old_claim: GACC approval covers exports to China
new_evidence: Public excerpts do not show SKU, application or producing establishment; a new plant likely needs own registration
correction: Route plant->China enabled only after gacc_delay_years for new plants; status unknown for Orindiúva SKUs
potential_impact: China sales from a new Thai plant delayed

new_evidence: Noise levels set from confidence labels without calibration, no correlation; output is propagation of assumed noise, not an objective probability
correction: v3 MC on economics uses justified ranges, Gaussian copula with stated correlations (PSD checked), reports conditional probabilities, p10/p50/p90, ES and a zero-correlation robustness run
potential_impact: Probabilities to be read as conditional

new_evidence: Missing metrics raise the score if the remaining metrics are good
correction: v3 reports coverage and min/max bounds (missing set to 0 and 10) for each country
potential_impact: None in current data (only flagged gaps)

new_evidence: Flags are national; non-compensatory gates must be site-level
correction: v3 site gates PASS/REVIEW/FAIL/NOT_VERIFIED with basis
potential_impact: Gates mostly NOT_VERIFIED -> decision is conditional

new_evidence: Bounds were chosen after seeing the data (post hoc); scores near bounds saturate
correction: v3 robustness run widens each bound by +/-25% and reports rank changes
potential_impact: Small

new_evidence: Judgement only; CABIO capacity from marketplace listing (S014), not audited
